observations: B-WHOLE seed 1 is visibly less congested than B-WHOLE-BASELINE while retaining a full, coherent mature-beech silhouette and recognizable beech character.
B-BARE seed 1 reduces the baseline's branch congestion without a material loss of branch character; the construction remains above the finish-quality floor demonstrated by the spruce anchor.

The crown remains notably upright and narrow relative to the photographic beech references, and weighted lateral droop remains limited; these are unresolved species-character refinements but do not block this bounded partial-improvement comparison.
